notes.title: FREE THE SKIES!
notes.notes:
A belated Happy new year to all!

[i]Secure The Skies[/i] will be changed to a free-to-play title soon. The plan is to make the switch during the month of February 2024. This change has been agreed upon due to the itch.io version, and android version being free to play as well. 
Thank you to everyone who supported STS during these last few years!


Best,
DUG team
